name: Sort The Capybaras
summary: 1 到 4 人的水豚玩具整理模拟，2026 年 10 月 8 日上架，Red Panda Studio 开发并发行，分类为休闲／模拟：把 4800 余只、240 种设计的玩具水豚一只只归位上架，用强力技能把杂乱店铺收成整齐的收藏墙。商店 AI 披露说明部分游戏模型网格在 AI 协助下制作、AI 也用于帮助修改其中一些模型，同时点明团队有一名玩具设计美术与一名模型美术负责自有设计的造型。本站据此把美术登记为已使用，其余七个领域（游戏运行、代码、音乐、配音、撰写、翻译、宣传素材）因披露没有点名而登记为未说明，披露也没有说明运行期是否会生成内容。本次公开报道检索只命中商店页一个结果，没有任何可读取的第三方转录或报道可登记。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（原文未被截断）、身份（开发与发行均为 Red Panda Studio，正式版，2026 年 10 月 8 日）与英文讨论区首页：可见 15 个主题、总数 35，即只覆盖首页，可见主题为缺失物品、录像条款与显示异常等，没有 AI 相关讨论。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，只有 1 条结果且为本作商店页，已由官方取证），因此本条没有登记任何补充来源；检索无结果只说明检索范围，不能证明披露之外没有 AI 用途，也未使用需登录的社交或视频平台做补充检索。判定只以商店披露原文为准。

english.summary: A cosy organising simulator for 1 to 4 players released on Oct 8, 2026, developed and published by Red Panda Studio and filed under Casual and Simulation, where you sort more than 4,800 capybara toys across 240 unique designs onto their proper shelves and use powerful skills to turn a messy shop into a tidy collection wall. The Steam AI disclosure states that some of the game model meshes were crafted with AI support and that AI was used to help edit some of the models, alongside a note that one artist creates the toy designs and a model artist builds the studios own designs. This site records art as used with the some limit kept and the other seven areas as not addressed, because the disclosure never names them and never says whether anything is generated at run time. The single web search for this game returned only the store page, so no third party transcription or press report could be registered, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, the identity (Red Panda Studio as both developer and publisher, a full release dated Oct 8, 2026) and the first page of the English discussion board, which shows 15 visible topics out of 35 in total, so only the front page was covered and its threads concern missing items, video streaming terms and an invisibility bug, with no AI topic. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json, and its single result was the games own Steam store page, already covered by the official evidence, so no supplemental press, developer or community source is registered for this entry at all. An empty search says only something about the search scope, never that no other AI use exists, and no signed in social or video platforms were used for extra coverage. The judgement rests entirely on the store disclosure text.
